d: Can a cumin-flavoured Indian soda take on Coca-Cola and Pepsi? Meet Lahori Zeera, the homegrown fizzy drink that is giving global cola giants a serious challenge. What began as a kitchen experiment by three cousins in 2017 has grown into a multi-million-dollar beverage business. Meanwhile, Violent protests have erupted across Bangladesh after the banned Awami League party carried out nationwide demonstrations. The protests come after former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina was denied a new passport by Prime Minister Tarique Rahman's government. Hem Kaur Saroya tells you more on Vantage on…
